entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Ajmer

entities.summary: The Diocese of Ajmer is a Latin Church diocese of the Catholic Church. It is a suffragan diocese in the ecclesiastical province of Agra in northwestern India, yet still depends on the missionary Roman Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples.
